traces.decision_summary: We do not write graded projects or guarantee grades, as we provide coaching to help students learn and improve.
traces.answer: I can't write your graded project or promise a grade. But I can help you understand your project better and coach you on how to plan, build, test, and explain it yourself. This way, you learn valuable skills and take ownership of your work. Would you like to tell me about your project so I can suggest the best coaching service for you?
